jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Startups (Life Sciences)
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

As an Applied AI Engineer on the Startups team at Anthropic, you will be a trusted technical advisor to the top AI-native life sciences and biotech startups as they grow from early product to scale. Some of these companies build products on Claude that they sell to the rest of the industry, and others do the science themselves and want Claude woven into how their own research runs, and this role works with both. You'll lead deep technical engagements, partnering directly with startup engineering and scientific teams to help them build their products on Claude and run their own research with it, advising on implementation and agent design as they build what is newly possible with AI in the life sciences. You will bridge the gap between what Claude can do and what the life sciences need, working alongside some of the strongest teams in the field on problems that matter and pushing the boundaries of AI in science as you go.

Working closely with Applied AI Architects, Account Executives, and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams, you'll help startups build at the edge of what is possible with Claude. You'll leverage your AI engineering expertise and your scientific domain knowledge to develop custom evaluation frameworks, design scalable architectures, and create the technical resources that enable life sciences startups to succeed with Claude.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Serve as a deep technical advisor to high-potential life sciences and biotech startups, whether Claude sits inside the product they sell or inside the way they make discoveries, working alongside them to build innovative use cases that push the boundaries of AI in scientific research and development
* Work hands-on with startup engineering teams and their scientists through pair programming and architecture reviews that accelerate their development, and understand their scientific workflows end to end so that your guidance fits into real research pipelines
* Develop prototypes and technical documentation, including evaluation suites, scientifically grounded benchmarks, AI engineering techniques, and architecture diagrams, that enable startups to build, operate, and scale with Claude
* Create reference implementations and sample code that many companies can adopt without starting from scratch, such as example MCP servers for domain-specific data sources like genomics platforms, literature databases, and experimental repositories, along with agent skills for common scientific workflows
* Collaborate closely with Applied AI Architects to maintain context and continuity across customer engagements
* Identify patterns across engagements, including what is hard about deploying AI in the life sciences such as heterogeneous data, auditability requirements, and the gap between a working prototype and a system that scientists trust, and contribute insights back to Product, Engineering, Research, and the broader Applied AI team, including feedback on the model capabilities and product features that would most accelerate discovery work
* Create technical content for startup audiences including documentation, tutorials, and sample code
* Represent Anthropic across the life sciences startup ecosystem and foster community engagement through hackathons, webinars, technical office hours, in-person founder events, and research show and tells
* Travel to customer sites for workshops, implementation guidance, and relationship building

**You may be a good fit if you have**
-------------------------------------

* Deep experience in the life sciences or biotech, gained through research or industry work in areas such as genomics, drug discovery, molecular design, lab automation, or clinical development, along with strong opinions of your own about how to bridge the gap between what AI can do today and what the life sciences need
* 4+ years of technical experience as a software engineer, ML or research engineer, computational biologist, research scientist, or technical founder, with either production experience building LLM-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale, or a track record of successfully applying AI to real scientific work in the lab or in research
* Experience with startups or high-growth companies and a love of working with founders and small teams that move quickly
* Strong technical communication skills, with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into architectural decisions and actionable implementation plans for both engineering and scientific audiences and to run technical workshops, hackathons, or developer-focused events
* A collaborative approach to working across teams, the ability to context-switch across scientific domains and use cases, and a passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial

jobs.description:
### **About Mainspring**

Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:

* Pragmatic Optimism
* Excellence without Ego
* Proactive Collaboration

### **Job Overview**

Mainspring is seeking a Senior Product Integration Engineer (CAD) to own and maintain the integrated CAD definition of the Linear Generator as designs evolve. Design Engineers will continue to own the technical design and subsystem CAD; this role will make sure those designs are incorporated into authoritative POR and future-state reference assemblies and work together correctly in the context of the complete product.

This role combines product-definition ownership with hands-on whole-product CAD integration. The ideal candidate is exceptionally strong in 3D CAD, understands how complex mechanical systems fit together, and enjoys resolving packaging, interface, and configuration problems across multiple engineering teams. This role will be a key user of CATIA for full-product assemblies that exceed the practical limits of SolidWorks.

### **Core Responsibilities**

* Build, maintain, and continuously improve authoritative POR and future-state reference assemblies for the Linear Generator

* Integrate subsystem CAD from multiple Design Engineering teams into full-product CATIA assemblies and keep those assemblies current as engineering changes progress

* Maintain clean full-product CAD structure, references, interfaces, metadata, and configuration logic across major assemblies

* Perform packaging studies, interference checks, clearance reviews, routing studies, service-access checks, and assembly-access evaluations

* Identify conflicting space claims and work with Design Engineers to negotiate interfaces and converge on practical whole-product solutions

* Create and maintain reference geometry, interface geometry, envelopes, simplified models, and other integration artifacts needed to support cross-team design work

* Support design reviews with clear visualizations of clashes, interfaces, access constraints, and product-level integration risks

* Identify and resolve inconsistencies among integrated CAD, drawings, EBOM structure, and the intended product configuration before release

* Support Product Release and Configuration Management by providing a clear, traceable digital definition of the product state being released

* Help establish scalable methods and standards for CATIA, large-assembly performance, imported geometry, simplification, reference assemblies, and cross-CAD workflows

### **Qualifications**

* BS in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience

* 5+ years of experience in mechanical CAD, product design, packaging, product integration, or complex equipment design

* Advanced proficiency with CATIA, NX, Creo, SolidWorks, or another advanced 3D CAD platform; strong CATIA experience is highly preferred

* Demonstrated experience building and maintaining large, complex, multi-subsystem assemblies with disciplined reference and configuration practices

* Strong mechanical intuition and ability to identify packaging, clearance, routing, serviceability, assembly, and interface issues from 3D CAD

* Strong understanding of mechanical interfaces, drawings, GD&T, BOMs, revisions, and engineering change workflows

* Ability to communicate spatial and interface problems clearly and collaborate with engineers from multiple subsystem teams

* Detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable coordinating multiple design changes that affect interfacing hardware

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience integrating products containing structures, piping/tubing, electrical hardware, thermal systems, enclosures, and serviceable components

* Experience with SolidWorks-to-CATIA or other multi-CAD integration workflows

* Experience with ENOVIA, 3DEXPERIENCE, or another PLM/PDM system

* Experience in complex industrial equipment, aerospace, automotive, robotics, energy systems, or another highly integrated hardware product

This position is **onsite** at our **Menlo Park HQ**. The salary will be adjusted to reflect local market conditions based on employee location as well as the experience of the employee. Along with the base salary, Mainspring offers pre-IPO stock options + benefits.

**Position Summary**

The Research Associate supports daily operations in our CLIA/CAP-regulated clinical diagnostics laboratory. Responsibilities span hands-on wet-lab work (cell culture and assay support), clinical sample accessioning, chain-of-custody activities and customer-facing coordination. The role requires strong technical competence, meticulous documentation, and a service-oriented approach to maintain compliance, turnaround time, and quality.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Clinical Laboratory Operations (CLIA/CAP)**

· Perform laboratory activities in accordance with CLIA, CAP, and laboratory SOPs, including documentation, data integrity, and change-control requirements.

· Maintain accurate records in LIMS/ELN systems for samples, reagents, QC/QA activities, and test-related documentation.

· Support internal audits, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and continuous improvement initiatives as assigned.

· Assist with equipment maintenance, calibration verification, inventory control, and reagent lot tracking.

**Cell Culture and Assay Support**

· Perform routine mammalian cell culture (primary cells and/or established cell lines), including thawing, passaging, counting, viability assessment, and cryopreservation.

· Prepare media, buffers, and reagents; maintain aseptic technique and follow biosafety procedures.

· Support clinical diagnostic assays through sample preparation, plating, labeling, QC checks, and basic data review (per training and authorization).

· Document deviations, troubleshoot basic workflow issues, and escalate technical concerns to senior staff as appropriate.

**Clinical Sample Accessioning and Chain of Custody**

· Receive, inspect, and accession clinical specimens per SOPs, test requisitions, and acceptance criteria.

· Verify identifiers, requisitions, specimen integrity, and shipping/temperature conditions; resolve discrepancies while maintaining compliance.

· Label, aliquot, store, and route samples to appropriate workflow stages with strict chain-of-custody and temperature control.

· Coordinate sample shipments and returns as needed, including packaging and documentation consistent with applicable regulations.

**Customer Service and Client Coordination**

· Serve as a point of contact for specimen status updates, kit logistics, requisition questions, and general support inquiries.

· Communicate professionally with clinicians, clinical sites, and internal stakeholders to resolve sample issues and support turnaround time commitments.

· Track inquiries and resolutions to ensure timely follow-up and clear documentation.

**Required Qualifications**

· Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biomedical Engineering, or a related life-science field (or equivalent practical experience).

· 1 to 3+ years of relevant experience in a clinical diagnostics, regulated laboratory, or comparable environment.

· Demonstrated hands-on experience with mammalian cell culture and aseptic technique.

· Experience accessioning clinical specimens and maintaining chain-of-custody documentation; LIMS experience strongly preferred.

· Strong customer service skills with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with external clients.

· Prior experience working in a CLIA and/or CAP-accredited laboratory environment is highly desirable.

· Familiarity with quality systems (SOPs, deviations, CAPA, internal audits, document control, inventory management).

· Experience with barcode-based sample tracking and regulated data systems (LIMS/ELN).

· Knowledge of biosafety requirements (BSL-2), clinical specimen handling, and relevant shipping regulations. Core Competencies

· High attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and consistent documentation habits.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment while maintaining quality standards.

· Service orientation: responsive, solutions-focused communication with clients and internal teams.

· Integrity and accountability in handling clinical specimens and patient-related data.

· Team collaboration with the ability to work independently when needed.

**Work Environment and Physical Requirements**

· Laboratory-based role requiring adherence to PPE and biosafety procedures (typically BSL-2).

· Ability to stand for extended periods; perform repetitive pipetting; lift and move materials up to approximately 25 lbs.

· May require occasional schedule flexibility to support sample receipt timelines and operational needs.

Pay: $32.00 - $35.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 – 20.0 per week

* Help improve the existing process by providing feedback and ideas to the assay development team.
